education: National University of Singapore, Bachelor's Degree, Sep 2016 - Aug 2019
introduction: I'm a software architect based in Malaysia with 8+ years building distributed systems and AI products. Most recently I've been working on AI mentoring platforms, meeting intelligence, and voice-agent SaaS — the kind of work where architecture choices actually show up in latency, reliability, and whether the product feels magical or fragile. I care a lot about shipping things people use: clear system design, practical AI (agents, RAG, real-time pipelines), and teams that move fast without painting themselves into a corner. I'm looking for a co-founder who brings the product and business side so we can build something ambitious together.

achievements.1: At Fathom, I led a bot-free meeting recording rewrite (Google Meet, Zoom, Teams, and more) that replaced a six-year legacy architecture — and got a production-ready POC out in three months.
achievements.2: At MMIVIP, I built AI voice-agent platforms handling 10,000+ daily API requests under 300ms, improved API throughput by ~48%, cut infra cost ~25% by consolidating microservices, and kept 99.9% availability for 50,000+ monthly users.
achievements.3: At Loom, I helped ship AI features like Auto Titles, Auto Summaries, and Auto Chapters, and built cloud-native video pipelines so those features could run at real product scale.

more_about_you.equity_expectations: I'm open to an equal equity split with a co-founder, in line with YC's recommendation.

cofounder_preferences.looking_for: Looking for a non-technical co-founder to own Product, Design, Sales and marketing, and Operations — shaping the product vision, crafting the experience, driving go-to-market, and running day-to-day business execution.
